---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
my_data <- read.csv("PVJ Data - Sheet1.csv")

# View(my_data)

names(my_data) <- as.character(unlist(my_data[1, ]))

my_data <- my_data[-1, ]

my_data <- my_data[
  !is.na(my_data$Course) & my_data$Course != "", 
]




```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
ggplot(my_data, aes(x = Subject, fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Level) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Courses by Subject, Grade, and Level",
    x = "Subject",
    y = "Number of Courses",
    fill = "Grade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(1))
```
```{r}
ggplot(my_data, aes(x = Grade, fill = factor(Level))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Subject, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Grade Distribution by Subject and Course Level",
    x = "Grade",
    y = "Number of Courses",
    fill = "Course Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```
